description: Procedures to protect intellectual property rights are not implemented.
applicability: Applies when an organization lacks appropriate procedures to protect intellectual property rights related to information assets, including software licensing compliance, protection of proprietary information, and respecting third-party intellectual property rights.

metadata.detection_notes: Review intellectual property policies and procedures, verify software license management processes, check for proprietary information protection measures, assess copyright and patent compliance, examine vendor license audits and compliance records.
